plan.scope: Exploratory distinct-day local chronological contrast prediction. Five shared stations, two changed; different excluded target and reference allowlist. Not isolated day causality, cross-day coefficient transfer, absolute future RF, new confirmation or covariance qualification.
plan.stopping_rule: One fixed hour and full declared cohort; retain failures and unsupported predictions, no station or time replacements.

prediction_quantity: station/epoch clock-free residual contrasts; receiver clocks recalibrated at test epochs
